name: Silfex Inc
old_description: We are the leading provider of precision silicon components used to make and operate semiconductor manufacturing equipment – which enable the trillion-dollar global electronics industry.
about:
Silfex Inc was founded in 2006 in Eaton, Ohio, as a division of Lam Research Corporation. The company began as a specialized supplier of precision silicon components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

The company grows and machines custom silicon components, including plasma distribution products, for semiconductor processing and test applications. Its capabilities encompass silicon crystal growing, precision machining with a focus on accuracy and reproducibility for etch uniformity, and advanced damage-free hole drilling. Silfex describes its facility as the world's largest custom silicon components growing and manufacturing operation, though specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Silfex serves the semiconductor equipment industry, providing components used in the manufacture of devices ranging from smartphones to solar panels. Its customers include semiconductor equipment makers and adjacent high-technology markets. The company works with customers and suppliers globally.

Silfex emphasizes collaboration to deliver high-quality products and top-tier processes, positioning its components as critical for enabling the global electronics industry. The company's stated differentiation lies in its precision machining capabilities that support etch uniformity and wafer quality.
